title: The Correlation of Women's Sexual Health and Marijuana Use
brief_summary: This study is attempting to determine whether there is any effect (worsening or improvement of sexual function) after marijuana consumption. Both users and non users of marijuana will be given the opportunity to participate by completing a questionnaire.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Female ages 18 to 90 years old, agree to fill out questionnaire

Exclusion Criteria:

Male, Female age less than 18 or over 90 years old, decline to fill out questionnaire
study_population: Patient participants will be asked upon check-in at their ob/gyn office whether they would like to participate in the questionnaire study. Patients will be asked to complete their questionnaire in the exam room of the ob/gyn practice. Patients who choose to voluntarily participate in the study, will be instructed to place their anonymous questionnaire in a provided blank envelope and seal it as to ensure confidentiality, then return their completed questionnaire to the front desk and place the sealed envelope in a lock box themselves.
